title: The 3 move minimum for a week that has no room
caption: Minimum workout for a busy work week: three movements, three patterns, seven minutes. Sit-to-Stand for squat, Doorframe Lean Row for pull, Glute Bridge for hinge. The same three every day, so the plan never asks you anything. Save this for the week everything lands at once.

overlays.text: Do these 3 every day this week. Decide nothing else.
Sit-to-Stand. 8 reps. Out of your desk chair with no hands, back down slowly.
Doorframe Lean Row. 10 reps. Hold the frame, lean back, pull yourself in.
Glute Bridge. 10 reps. Lie down by the desk, feet flat, push your hips up.

scenes.footer: Shrink the plan, never the standard.

overlays.text: No push and no core this week. They come back when the week opens up.

scenes.footer: Ten minutes is complete. So is seven.

overlays.text: Three rounds of the three. Seven minutes, start to finish.

scenes.footer: Save this for the week everything lands at once.
